schematic.tooltip.body: Raises a ship with fewer than {points} Hull Upgrade points to {points}. Apply it on the Hull Upgrades panel in the refit screen. It is consumed.
schematic.tooltip.disabled: Hull Upgrades are switched off in LunaLib settings. Switch them back on to apply this.
schematic.tooltip.chartMode: Star Chart Progress is on in LunaLib settings, so this can't be applied.
schematic.tooltip.storage: Opening Hull Item Storage or the Hull Upgrades panel moves this from your cargo into storage.
framework.panel.title: Hull Upgrades
framework.confirm.title: Apply a {name}?
framework.confirm.body.one: This ship will have {points} of {max} Hull Upgrade points. The schematic will be consumed. You currently have {count} schematic.
framework.confirm.body.other: This ship will have {points} of {max} Hull Upgrade points. The schematic will be consumed. You currently have {count} schematics.
framework.panel.hintCharts: Clearing Star Charts raises every ship's points, up to {max}. Spend points to unlock sections. Locking a section again returns its point.
framework.panel.upgradeReady: Click to apply. It is consumed and raises this ship to {points} points.
framework.panel.upgradeAtMax: This ship already has the maximum of {max} points.
framework.panel.upgradeNone: You have none. Refit Schematics drop from salvage, Tech Mining and battles once you reach level {level}.
framework.panel.chartsNext: Clear a tier {tier} Star Chart to raise every ship to {points} points.
framework.panel.chartsMax: Every ship has the maximum of {max} points from Star Charts.
framework.panel.chartsOff: Star Chart Progress needs Star Charts, which are switched off, so every ship has 1 point.
masterSchematic.panel.heading: Skill Tree
masterSchematic.panel.locked: This ship's skill tree is locked until a Master Schematic is used on it.
masterSchematic.panel.ready: Click to use. It is consumed and opens this ship's skill tree.
masterSchematic.panel.already: This ship's skill tree is already open.
masterSchematic.panel.none: You have none. Master Schematics drop from battles, salvage, Tech Mining and Star Charts.
masterSchematic.confirm.body.one: This ship's skill tree opens permanently. The schematic will be consumed. You currently have {count} schematic.
masterSchematic.confirm.body.other: This ship's skill tree opens permanently. The schematic will be consumed. You currently have {count} schematics.
masterSchematic.tooltip.body: Opens one ship's skill tree permanently. Use it on the Hull Upgrades panel in the refit screen. It is consumed.
masterSchematic.tooltip.flavour: Every hull mod is written for a generic hull. This file is written for exactly one, by the people who built it. A refit crew working from it can adjust the ship's hull in much finer detail.
masterSchematic.tooltip.notRequired: Master Schematics aren't required in LunaLib settings, so every skill tree is open.
points.chartRaised: Star Chart cleared: every ship now has {points} Hull Upgrade points.
framework.sectionHint.unlocked: Click to lock this section again. Its point is returned and any hull item in it goes back to storage.
framework.sectionHint.available: Click to spend a Hull Upgrade point on this section.
framework.sectionHint.restricted: This ship cannot use this section with its current fit.
framework.sectionHint.noPoints: Apply a Refit Schematic to gain a point for this section.
framework.sectionHint.noPointsCharts: Clear a higher tier Star Chart to gain a point for this section.
framework.sectionDescription.bridge: Holds command suites for combat readiness, weapon handling and how hard the ship hits each hull size.
framework.sectionDescription.crew_quarte: Holds specialist crews for crew capacity, upkeep, repairs, sensors, electronic warfare and salvage.
framework.sectionDescription.engine_room: Holds drive assemblies for speed, maneuverability, burn level and fuel economy.
framework.sectionDescription.reactor: Holds power regulators for venting, capacitors, EMP resistance and weapon flux costs.
framework.sectionDescription.armor_plati: Holds bolt-on plating for armor, hull and damage resistance.
framework.sectionDescription.weapon_moun: Holds fire control for weapon damage, range, ammunition and point defense.
framework.sectionDescription.shield_gene: Holds shield emitters for shield efficiency, upkeep, arc and response.
framework.sectionDescription.phase_coil: Holds phase coils for cloak cost, phase speed and stealth.
framework.sectionDescription.flight_deck: Holds launch assemblies for strikecraft replacement, refit times and strikecraft performance.
framework.section.removeHint: Right-click the section to return this hull item to storage, or click it to choose a different one.
ui.socketStorage.placingHintFramework: Click the highlighted {type} section on the ship to install {name}. Esc cancels.
ui.socketStorage.placingHintFrameworkLoc: This ship has no {type} section unlocked for {name}. Unlock it in Hull Upgrades first. Esc cancels.
ui.hullItemsLevelNotice.defaultLevel: By default, hull items and upgrades do not appear until you are level {level}.
ui.hullItemsLevelNotice.level: Hull items and upgrades do not appear until you are level {level}.
ui.hullItemsLevelNotice.setting: You can configure this in LunaLib.
settings.hullItems.hullUpgrades.name: Enabled
settings.hullItems.hullUpgrades.tooltip: When off, Refit Schematics and hull items other than Subroutines stop dropping, and unlocked sections stop working until it's switched back on.
settings.hullItems.dropLevel.name: Hull Item Drops From Player Level
settings.hullItems.dropLevel.tooltip: Player level at which Refit Schematics and hull items start dropping.
settings.hullItems.hullUpgradePoints.too: Refit Schematics raise a ship straight to their tier, up to 5. Star Chart Progress raises every ship to 2, 3 and 4 points as you clear tier 5, 10 and 15 Star Charts, and needs Star Charts switched on.
settings.hullItems.masterSchematics.name: Require Master Schematics
settings.hullItems.masterSchematics.tool: Each ship's skill tree stays locked until a Master Schematic is used on it. NPC trees only mirror ships with an open tree. Ships that already have nodes are unlocked when this is switched on. Needs Hull Upgrades.
settings.hullItems.battleItems.name: Hull Item Drops From Battles
settings.hullItems.battleItems.tooltip: Covers hull items and schematics, including Logistics Schematics. 100 is normal and 0 turns them off.
